content: On the pitch, Chelsea produced a stunning performance to beat PSG 3-0 and upset the odds.
"For football fans outside the USA, the lead-up to Sunday's Club World Cup final featuring Chelsea and European champions Paris St-Germain was vibrant, engaging, and perhaps slightly bewildering."

'On Sunday, Chelsea will face a challenging task in trying to halt their opponents. Since the Coupe de France final, PSG has secured victory in their last five knockout stage matches, winning with a total score of 18-0.'
